title: Electrode Boilers: Unlocking Grid Flexibility in District Heating Systems
summary: As renewable energy adoption continues to grow, district heating systems have an opportunity to do more than provide reliable heat. Electrode boilers can help operators reduce emissions, support grid stability, and improve system economics by serving as both heat-producing assets and flexible electrical loads.
